outline:
本課程透過個案分析，了解全球與台灣知名企業在顧客服務上獨特之處，個案所涵蓋領域包含服務業、製造業、飯店業、旅遊航空業、餐飲業等，透過討論在顧客關係管理上的重要議題如顧客體驗、抱怨管理、服務文化、服務創新等，並使同學能夠對於顧客關係管理在最佳實務上運作有進一步了解。
This course analyzes the cases to help students understand the factors of successful companies in customer relationship management. The selected cases cover different industries such as service industry, hotel industry, travel and airline industry, and restaurant industry. The course aims to synthesize popular issues such as customer experience, compliant management, service culture, service innovation and so on and provide the how best practices worked in the real world.
schedule:
Week 1: Orientation
Week 2: CRM concept
Week 3: Customer Experience / Case: Southwest Airline & Singapore Airline
Week 4: Customer Activity & Co-Production / Case: Harrah’s Hotel & Hilton
Week 5: The Customer Lens / Case: Starbucks & IKEA
Week 6: Service Experience / Undercover Boss: Frontier Airline
Week 7: Customer Perception and Evaluation / Case: Nordstrom & Macy's
Week 8: Movie analysis
Week 9: Complaint Management / Case: Zappos & Amazon
Week 10: The Profitable Art of Service Marketing
Week 11: Service Climate
Week 12: Service Innovation / Case: Uniqlo & Zara
Week 13: Technology Adoption
Week 14: Service Blueprint
Week 15: Customer Ecosystems / Case: Uber & BlaBlaCar
Week 16: The Use of Customer Data / Undercover Boss: 1-800-Flowers
Week 17: Final Presentation
